text: Lower bounds: smallest net that still makes patterns worth looking at
description:
Sweep layers, hidden width, tap count and mip levels down from nice-net; time net.frag at 1024-2048 px per eye (desktop and Frame). Record the curve weights/ms vs a by-eye rating. Where does it stop being interesting?

Research 2026-11-24: muNCA (Mordvintsev & Niklasson 2021, arXiv 2111.13545) makes textures with a few hundred parameters, down to 68; a GLSL generator is a few lines. nice-net has 4920, so sweep far lower: hidden [8] or [4], 2-3 mip levels, few hidden-state channels. First run: nice-net's config with hidden [8], from scratch, judged with evaluate.py's sharpness/contrast.
